versions.changelog:
Initial release of scrapfly-screenshot.

- Capture high-quality screenshots of web pages using the Scrapfly Screenshot API via Python SDK.
- Supports full-page, viewport, or element-specific screenshots, with anti-bot bypass and JavaScript rendering.
- Flexible options: image format (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF), custom resolutions, geo-targeting, banner blocking, dark mode, and custom JavaScript execution.
- Features error handling, caching, and accessibility testing (vision deficiencies).
- Includes detailed usage examples and setup instructions.
